text_block_list.text:
On my way back from shopping at the commercial district,
I bumped into Mr. C.B.,
so as we walked together—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, I wonder what's going on?
Everyone's buzzing.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, a lottery raffle, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That light, clattering sound it makes
when it spins is so nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's fun wondering what you'll win.
Maybe I'll go take a look.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll go with you.

text_block_list.text:
I remembered I had received a raffle ticket
while shopping earlier.
I decided to hand it to her.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you.
Well then, I think I'll take you up on that.

Eventually her turn came—
and Mr. C.B. briskly
turned the lottery wheel's handle!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A hot spring, huh? Sounds nice. What an exciting ring to it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a place surrounded by nature, huh...
And their hot springs and food are their pride and joy... got it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sounds like fun!
I feel like I'll get to experience things I normally never could.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently these tickets are for two people.
So one of them is for you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still... what should I do? I'm not really
in the mood to go right this second.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: There's still so much more I want to do right now, and—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah,
I think I'll let it sit for a while.
choice_data_list: Hmm, maybe I'll do the same then.
Maybe I'll do that too, then.

text_block_list.text:
I told them it was because, right now, I wanted to support
what Mr. C.B. 'wants to do' with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Let's use them whenever either of us wants to go.
If our schedules align, we could even go together."

Dreaming of the day they'd visit the hot springs,
they vowed to focus on the task right in front of them for now.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I hadn't prepared anything
for dinner tonight, so this is a huge help.
choice_data_list: Then want to buy some side dishes too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Sounds good to me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Should I stop by the supermarket,
or check out the deli shop—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right, since we're here, why don't you tell me your recommendation?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You live on your own too, right?
I'd really love to use your routine as a reference.
choice_data_list: Then let's take the long way around.

text_block_list.text: After that, I showed her around the shopping street for a while, visiting the greengrocer, bento shop, and other places I often go to.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wah, that's an incredible amount of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy, but what should we do?
Even split between the two of us, it's quite a lot.
choice_data_list: Like using it in cooking, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I'm not really very good at that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, I should ask Maruzen for advice!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Someone gave me a bunch of vegetables once, and when I asked her for help, she quickly turned them into preserved food. That was a huge lifesaver~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then for now,
let's take it home!

Dreaming of all the carrot dishes we could make,
I carried back a mountain of carrots
alongside Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice.
I was just getting hungry.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's split it in half first, and then—
No sooner had she said that than Mr. C.B. snapped the carrot in two—
(――*munch, munch, munch*)
She devoured one of them right then and there—!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That was delicious. Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, is something wrong?
choice_data_list: No... you just caught me a bit off guard.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Did I startle you?
I just thought it'd be perfect for a snack.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give you this one too.

text_block_list.text:
I'm not hungry right now, so
I decided to give the other half to her as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Are you sure? Well then, I won't hesitate."
We headed back to the academy to the sound of Mr. C.B. crunching away on her carrot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm... A miss, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever.
Tissues are low-key pretty handy anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I just put it in my pocket for now,
the day will come when I'll use it.
Looking just a little lonely, Mr. C.B. stuffed the non-winning consolation tissue pack into her pocket.
